name: dsh-guide-ui
description: Mid-task guidance for DeepSeek Harness, with a header badge switch.

scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const bad=[];for(const f of ['package.json','cordis.patch.yml','client.js','index.js']){try{const b=fs.readFileSync(f);if(b[0]===0xEF&&b[1]===0xBB&&b[2]===0xBF)bad.push(f)}catch(e){}}if(bad.length){console.error('UTF-8 BOM in: '+bad.join(', '));process.exit(1)}JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('package.json','utf8'));console.log('manifest ok')"

author: sakikoTGW
